name: Divider band
for: A short band between two sections that names the next part of the page: an eyebrow, one headline, one line and a link, with quiet topographic lines on the far side.
how: The effect host starts 48px past the end of the copy's widest line (measured) and fades in from that side; stacked, it sits under the copy. Each effect has quiet settings in component.js, all still: the band is drawn once and kept as a picture (no WebGL context and no frames at rest), so it needs no pause button.
rules: At most one band per page, never two in a row.
Quiet line or dot effects only: no blobs or bokeh.
ridgeline only when the page names it (alone it reads as a record cover).
No line starts under the text: keep 48px clear after the copy.
The band never moves with scroll.
a11y: A labelled section with a real heading and link; the lines are decorative and still.
